name: Almaden Valley
description: Family-friendly hillside community with top-rated schools, scenic trails, and some of San Jose's most desirable homes.

name: Willow Glen
description: Charming village feel with a walkable downtown, tree-lined streets, and a mix of historic bungalows and new construction.

name: Blossom Valley
description: Established, affordable neighborhoods with great freeway access, strong community character, and good value for the South Bay.

name: Campbell
description: Vibrant downtown dining scene, award-winning schools, and a tight-knit community feel just minutes from Los Gatos.

name: Los Gatos
description: Luxury village lifestyle with exceptional schools, hillside views, and one of the most sought-after zip codes in the Bay Area.

name: Los Altos
description: Premier location with one of the best school districts in California, quiet streets, and proximity to major tech employers.
